description: Haltestellen des ÖPNV im Landkreis Vorpommern-Rügen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. This dataset contains the locations of the bus stops of the district Vorpommern-Rügen with the exact name and, if necessary, comments on the individual stops. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Public transport stops in the Vorpommern-Rügen district" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Deutschland, Vorpommern-Rügen, inspireidentifiziert, Haltestellen, Bushaltestellen. The listing shows 2025-11-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
